digest.component_or_area: partial-clone test fixtures and Git protocol integration
propositions: Partial-clone test fixtures consume 32.69 worker-phase seconds due to >100MiB real object contrast duplicated per xdist worker
Protocol negotiation, missing-object, identity, and reconvergence test cases are size-independent and can use isolated small real-protocol fixtures rather than large ones
One large >140MiB object contrast guard must be retained and confined to a single xdist worker for full-versus-blobless pack validation
Isolated ephemeral Git daemons with explicit teardown on distinct ports prevent cross-worker contamination and mutable state sharing
Refactored fixture split reduced pytest wall time by 69.5%, real wall time by 78.5%, and setup overhead by 85.2% while maintaining protocol coverage
